scope: Current accepted supervised run scores and active applicable profile coordinates; 10/10/11 models x five saved seeds
empirical_quantile: Nearest rank, ceil(q*n)-1 on all within-configuration run pairs in a corpus; model pairs are dependent
radial_calibration: q80 of max(max(|delta P|,|delta R|)/0.02, max profile distance/0.05), then scale both original margins equally
stable_condition: Both configuration means pass the joint margins and at least 20 of 25 cross-configuration saved-run pairs pass them
limitations: Thresholds chosen from the same test panel are exploratory reference scales, not equivalence margins, significance tests, or a new confirmatory screen. Profiles condition on fixed gold and five saved training seeds.
